# drotmg

> Constructs a modified Givens plane rotation.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import drotmg from '@rreusser/blahpack/blas/drotmg';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
drotmg( dd1, dd2, dx1, dy1, param, strideParam ) → Float64Array
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dd1` | `Float64Array` | **in/out** · Input/output (length-1 array): `dd1` |
| `dd2` | `Float64Array` | **in/out** · Input/output (length-1 array): `dd2` |
| `dx1` | `Float64Array` | **in/out** · Input/output (length-1 array): `dx1` |
| `dy1` | `number` | Scalar value `dy1` |
| `param` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length 5</sub> | **out** · Five-element output array for the rotation parameters |
| ↳ `strideParam` | `integer` | Stride length for `param` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `param`: `DPARAM(1)=DFLAG` `DPARAM(2)=DH11` `DPARAM(3)=DH21` `DPARAM(4)=DH12` `DPARAM(5)=DH22`

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: `param`

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
drotmg.ndarray( dd1, dd2, dx1, dy1, param, strideParam, offsetParam ) → Float64Array
```

Constructs a modified Givens plane rotation.

The routine constructs the modified Givens transformation matrix `H` which
zeros the second component of the 2-vector
`(sqrt(dd1)*dx1, sqrt(dd2)*dy1)^T`.

With `DPARAM[0] = DFLAG`, `H` has one of the following forms:

```text
DFLAG=-1:     DFLAG=0:      DFLAG=1:      DFLAG=-2:

(DH11  DH12)  (1     DH12)  (DH11  1   )  (1  0)
(DH21  DH22)  (DH21  1   )  (-1    DH22)  (0  1)
```

Locations 1-4 of `DPARAM` contain `DH11`, `DH21`, `DH12`, and `DH22`
respectively. Values implied by the value of `DPARAM[0]` are not stored.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dd1` | `Float64Array` | **in/out** · Input/output (length-1 array): `dd1` |
| `dd2` | `Float64Array` | **in/out** · Input/output (length-1 array): `dd2` |
| `dx1` | `Float64Array` | **in/out** · Input/output (length-1 array): `dx1` |
| `dy1` | `number` | Scalar value `dy1` |
| `param` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length 5</sub> | **out** · Five-element output array for the rotation parameters |
| ↳ `strideParam` | `integer` | Stride length for `param` |
| ↳ `offsetParam` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `param` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `param`: `DPARAM(1)=DFLAG` `DPARAM(2)=DH11` `DPARAM(3)=DH21` `DPARAM(4)=DH12` `DPARAM(5)=DH22`

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: `param`

</section>

## Notes

-   `drotmg()` corresponds to the reference BLAS routine [`DROTMG`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/BLAS/SRC/drotmg.f).

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Float64Array from '@stdlib/array/float64/lib/index.js';
import drotmg from './../lib/base.js';

const D = new Float64Array( [ 1.0, 1.0 ] );
const x1 = new Float64Array( [ 3.0 ] );
const param = new Float64Array( 5 );

drotmg( D.subarray( 0, 1 ), D.subarray( 1, 2 ), x1.subarray( 0, 1 ), 4.0, param, 1, 0 );
console.log( param ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<section class="reference-notes">

## Reference notes

The mathematical description from the reference BLAS 3.12.0 source of `DROTMG`. Indices are the 1-based Fortran indices of the source.

### Purpose

CONSTRUCT THE MODIFIED GIVENS TRANSFORMATION MATRIX H WHICH ZEROS THE SECOND COMPONENT OF THE 2-VECTOR $(\mathrm{DSQRT}(\mathrm{DD1}) \, \mathrm{DX1},\mathrm{DSQRT}(\mathrm{DD2}) \, > \mathrm{DY2})^T$. WITH `DPARAM(1)=DFLAG`, H HAS ONE OF THE FOLLOWING FORMS..

$\mathrm{DFLAG}=-1$.D0 $\mathrm{DFLAG}=0$.D0 $\mathrm{DFLAG}=1$.D0 $\mathrm{DFLAG}=-2$.D0

$$
H= \begin{pmatrix} \mathrm{DH11} & \mathrm{DH12} \\  &  \\ \mathrm{DH21} & \mathrm{DH22} \end{pmatrix} , \begin{pmatrix} 1.D_{0} & \mathrm{DH12} \\  &  \\ \mathrm{DH21} & 1.D_{0} \end{pmatrix} , \begin{pmatrix} \mathrm{DH11} & 1.D_{0} \\  &  \\ -1.D_{0} & \mathrm{DH22} \end{pmatrix} , \begin{pmatrix} 1.D_{0} & 0.D_{0} \\  &  \\ 0.D_{0} & 1.D_{0} \end{pmatrix}
$$

LOCATIONS 2-4 OF `DPARAM` CONTAIN DH11, DH21, DH12, AND DH22 RESPECTIVELY. (VALUES OF 1.D0, -1.D0, OR 0.D0 IMPLIED BY THE VALUE OF `DPARAM(1)` ARE NOT STORED IN `DPARAM`.)

THE VALUES OF GAMSQ AND RGAMSQ SET IN THE DATA STATEMENT MAY BE INEXACT. THIS IS OK AS THEY ARE ONLY USED FOR TESTING THE SIZE OF `DD1` AND `DD2`. ALL ACTUAL SCALING OF DATA IS DONE USING GAM.

</section>

<!-- /.reference-notes -->
